description: Proposed toolchain, requirements package and governed contracts for the 7 November competition (kemiller2002/causa): the frozen v4.1.6 (tag indy-init-requirements-v4.1.6) with its WDL-013 plan supplement, the competition scope compiled with the fixed (V2) selectors (SS-1 A), Conditor v0.10.21 whose indy-init preset carries forma-workflow 1.2.0 and the test-deploy-key secrets step (ODR-COMP-P14 A, ODR-COMP-P13 A), causa-storage 1.1.0, and, carried unchanged from Rehearsal 010's lock, the resolved set echelon-current 1.37.0 (Dokimos 0.11.1), the process-evidence rules, the design contract, the deadline policy, the journey bindings and the isolated test repository. Change this file only through the owner decision process.

indyInit.commit: (the owner fills: the merge commit of the pull request that adds this lock, or a later main commit the owner names)
indyInit.rule: The competition is governed from this Indy-init commit or a later main commit that contains it: r9.fsx govern records the commit it ran from as .echelon/r9-governance.json indyInitCommit, and launch-preflight LP-00 judges origin/main. This proposal leaves it as a placeholder because the commit does not exist until the pull request is merged; the owner writes it when committing toolchain.lock.json (ODR-COMP-LOCK).

conditor.approval: ODR-COMP-P14 A (APR-COMP-OWNER-1): the indy-init preset pins forma-workflow 1.2.0 (exempted from the echelon-current selection test for exactly that component and version, Conditor PR #134) and its deploy template carries the ODR-COMP-P13 secrets step; released as v0.10.21 (commit 528ef45). The eight digests are those of the release's checksums.txt.

resolvedSet.approval: echelon-current 1.37.0 approved by the owner (sets/echelon-current/1.37.0.json, OD-INDY-8; echelon-registry#109 merged as 5752402) after Conditor qualified it (conditor#131)

status: PROPOSED: not an owner pin. Recorded: v4.1.6 (APR-V416-OWNER-1, APR-V416-OWNER-2; tag indy-init-requirements-v4.1.6 at 2380b3d), the ratified v4.1.6 catalog (ODR-V416-CAT, 877f9cd), the competition decisions ODR-COMP-P01..P14 (APR-COMP-OWNER-1), causa-storage-v1.1.0 (causa-data 7e10394). Pending, the owner's: ODR-COMP-SCOPE (the scope digest below), ODR-COMP-CATALOG-CONTRACT, ODR-COMP-P15 (dependencyLock), ODR-COMP-P16 (assertionMergeNeeds), ODR-COMP-LOCK, the live-provider run on the merged main, then committing this file as kickoff/competition/toolchain.lock.json with status set to the owner's pin and indyInit.commit filled (as ODR-RG-04).
